title: EngravePluginPack
description: Resourcepack for the Engraver for the EngravePlugin
body:
This is a resourcepack for the EngravePlugin. Without this resourcepack, the engraver item will look like a regular brick. Please feel free to use the json and png files in your own resourcepack for using with the plugin given that I am credited somewhere in the pack. 

EngravePlugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/engraveplugin
